content: Callback Names Differ from COM Model Element Names It is illegal for any of the ComUserCallbackName parameters in all Co- mUserCallback containers to have the same value as any of the following five pa- rameters • Com_<shortName of a ComSignal > • Com_<shortName of a ComSignalGroup > • Com_<shortName of a ComGroupSignal > • Com_<shortName of a ComIPdu > • Com_<shortName of a ComIPduGroup >
